A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original ImageNet classification, C4 language-model pretraining, XSum fine-tuning and distillation results, plus computational experiments in Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds five-seed statistical summaries for ImageNet, supervised fine-tuning and distillation.

M1.justification: The divergence-generated objectives, associated operators, differentiation procedures and bisection algorithm remain unchanged. The correction to Equation (6) does not change the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet-2012 classification, C4 pretraining and XSum summarization through fine-tuning and distillation. The added seed summaries introduce no new dataset, task or test scenario.

E2.justification: Tables 2 and 3 and Figure 3 retain their respective comparator sets. New Tables 4–6 summarize those existing comparisons; newly cited related methods are not evaluated.

E3.justification: Reported architectures, training budgets, splits, accuracy and ROUGE-2 metrics, and temperature-1 sampling remain unchanged. The newly disclosed seed counts concern uncertainty reporting rather than a revised evaluation design.

E4.justification: The alpha sweep, decoding comparison, learned-prior negative result, bisection convergence, runtime comparison and prior-distribution illustrations are retained. No new ablation or distinct robustness analysis accompanies the statistical summaries.

E5.justification: v1 provides no seed-count or dispersion summaries. New Appendix A.3 reports means, standard deviations, minima and maxima over five random seeds for ImageNet, SFT and distillation in Tables 4–6, substantially expanding uncertainty reporting. This does not establish an increase from any particular earlier run count.

E6.justification: Existing numerical tables and plotted results are retained, while Tables 4–6 add aggregate results for existing experiments. Table 6 reports mean distillation ROUGE-2 of 14.17 for Chi-square versus 16.64 for KL, conflicting with the retained Figure 3 and text ranking. These additions do not establish a same-setting performance improvement.

T1.justification: Equation (6) reverses the inequality from the Fenchel–Young loss being at most the corresponding Bregman divergence to being at least it. This corrects a mathematical relationship; Proposition 1 and the appendix derivations and proofs remain substantively unchanged.

C1.justification: The central claims about divergence-generated losses, non-uniform reference measures, parallelizable bisection and alpha=1.5 performance remain. The abstract's explicit Fenchel–Young attribution repeats the foundation already acknowledged in v1's introduction.

C2.justification: Section 3.2 newly states that formal axiomatic analysis of the proposed entropies is left to future work. The empirical mechanism explanations and applicability discussions otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation information, hyperparameters, model descriptions, TPU disclosures and benchmark/code references remain substantively unchanged. The added seed information is covered under E5.

R1.justification: Sections 3.2 and 5 add nine works covering earlier entropy constructions, variational divergence objectives, robust losses, GANs and variational inference. This broadens relevant context while retaining the original convexity-based positioning.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized abstract and entropy-discussion edits, expands related work, inserts Appendix A.3 and corrects terminology and spelling. It also updates publication information, replaces acknowledgments and removes author contributions; the overall narrative structure remains.

P2.justification: v2 adds three statistical tables and reflows surrounding appendix material. Table 1 replaces 'New' entries with dashes, and Figure 1 removes 'New' from two legend labels while retaining its curves. Other figures and the overall layout remain substantially the same.

improvement.justification: Correcting Equation (6), adding five-seed uncertainty information supporting the central alpha=1.5 finding, and improving prior-work coverage modestly strengthen the paper. The gain is limited by an unresolved reporting inconsistency: Table 6 contradicts Figure 3 and Section 4.2 about Chi-square outperforming KL in distillation.
